CustomField.description: Required when Is_Ramp_Deal__c = TRUE. Number of ramp delivery phases. Values 2-6. Drives how many Ramp Phase sets appear on Quote Lines.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Required when Ramp Deal is checked. Enter the number of capacity delivery phases (2 to 6). Controls how many ramp phase columns appear on each quote line.
